label: Liquid upload button
desc: Button that fills with two layered waves of liquid from the bottom as the upload progresses, with a percent label and a done state.
use: upload actions in a dashboard, publishing flow or media library

label: Neon send button
desc: Neon-glow send button whose glow intensifies on hover; on click the paper plane flies out and the button confirms with Sent and a glow pulse.
use: contact form, chat composer or newsletter sign-up

label: Neumorphic play button
desc: Soft embossed play/pause button that presses in, morphs its icon, shows a progress ring and a three-bar equalizer while playing (visual only).
use: audio or video previews, podcast and music sections on landing pages

label: Rippling download button
desc: Download button with a ripple from the click point, an arrow that drops into a tray, a progress ring and a final check.
use: download links for brochures, menus, invoices and reports

label: Ring rope upload
desc: Circular upload ring that unrolls into a straight progress bar, then tosses a file chip to the right end and shows a done check; falls back to a plain progress bar for reduced motion.
use: file upload field in a dashboard, application form or publishing flow
